body: Market caution: malaking household-level change ito for affected foreign residents, pero hindi pa justified na tawagin itong broad Japan labor-market negative. The macro channel would require behavior: lower skilled-worker retention, changed PR demand, or employers absorbing more immigration costs. Wala pang volume or employer-response evidence sa record na ito. So the investable lesson for now is measurement discipline—watch application volumes and company support policies before converting a severe per-person fee increase into a national growth or earnings thesis.
